title: Post-Training Agents for Long-Document Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.30090v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Professional documents are a long-context workload that retrieval-style benchmarks do not capture. In a ten-domain enterprise collection, a task's evidence is spread across a source document of median length 27 pages (mean 48.8, maximum 873); a third of tasks rest mainly on charts, drawings, and maps; and 70.9% require two or more reasoning hops. We post-train Kimi-K2.7, an open-weight foundation model, at its full context window on 1,465 expert-authored tasks with atomic rubrics from that collection, training rank-32 adapters with one round of privileged-context on-policy self-distillation followed by two rounds of rubric-reward reinforcement learning. We render each PDF as text for training and as extracted text plus selected page images at evaluation. translated_title: 面向长文档推理的智能体后训练
translated_abstract: 专业文档是一种检索式基准测试无法涵盖的长上下文工作负载。在一个涵盖十个领域的企业文档集合中，任务所需的证据分布在一篇中位数为27页（平均48.8页，最长873页）的源文档中；三分之一的任务主要依赖图表、绘图和地图；70.9%的任务需要两次或更多次推理跳转。我们对开源权重基础模型Kimi-K2.7在其完整上下文窗口上进行了后训练，使用了来自该集合的1,465个由专家撰写、配有原子化评分标准的任务，训练rank-32适配器，方法为一轮特权上下文在线策略自蒸馏，随后进行两轮基于评分标准奖励的强化学习。训练时我们将每个PDF渲染为文本，评估时则使用提取的文本加上选定的页面图像。平滑后的强化学习训练奖励从训练前期十分之一处的0.37上升到训练末期的0.67。在100个任务的GDP.pdf保留测试集上（以262,144 token窗口提供服务），严格通过（所有评分标准……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文通过对开源模型Kimi-K2.7在1,465个专家撰写的长文档任务上进行特权上下文自蒸馏与评分标准奖励强化学习的后训练，显著提升了模型对含图表和多跳推理的长篇专业文档的推理能力。
en_tdlr: Post-training the open-weight model Kimi-K2.7 with privileged-context self-distillation and rubric-reward reinforcement learning on 1,465 expert-authored tasks substantially improves long-document reasoning over professional documents featuring charts and multi-hop questions.
